annotations.title: Compare quotes and costs across exchanges

description: Use to choose where to trade one perpetual futures coin: bid, ask, spread, trading fee (your account's rate or the published one) and 7-day execution, per exchange. With side (and size_base or notional_usd): ranked by price plus taker fee plus a cost for poor execution; hold_hours adds funding, exit fee. cheapest_venue: cheapest overall; best_venue: cheapest you can trade on now (connected, allowed, enough margin); if they differ, say both. Not for one venue's depth (use get_order_book). No rebates. Next: preview_perp_order with best_venue, or venue "best".

hold_hours.description: Optional, with side: how long you expect to hold, in hours; adds funding at today's rate and the exit fee, and ranks by that total cost
hold_hours.title: Hold Hours

side.description: Optional: rank by the all-in price for this side (the price you would take plus the venue's taker fee)
side.title: Side

size_base.description: Optional, with side: size in the base coin, to see each venue's cost in USD and whether your free margin there covers it
size_base.title: Size Base

name: compare_perp_quotes_across_venues

quality_bps.description: With side: measured execution quality as a cost, basis points (the rule is in ranking_basis); 0 without executions
